The two ID-SPACE typed edge families, each dangling (UCS-1151). Kept in one
leaf so the two findings differ only in the family that produced them.

  concepts  K-999 is minted by no ontology entry and declared in no catalog —
            the ref graph's unresolved-ref, bought by the declaration alone.
  relates   L-000999 likewise, in the leaf space.

The third family, `paths`, lives in its own fixture (typed-edges-missing-path):
it names the repo tree rather than an id space, so it earns `missing-path` at
the structural validator instead — and a loader error here would gate that
validator to exit 2 before the check ever ran.
